q: The science of classification of organisms is called _____.
e: The science of classification of organisms is called Taxonomy. Taxonomy sorts living things into ranked groups so millions of species can be studied. Biodiversity would fill a different blank than Taxonomy.

q: The term 'biodiversity' is a short form of _____.
e: The term 'biodiversity' is a short form of biological diversity. Biological diversity is the idea that completes this fact. Biological division would fill a different blank than biological diversity.

q: The process of classification involves giving every organism an agreed name and placing it into a group based on _____.
e: The process of classification involves giving every organism an agreed name and placing it into a group based on common characteristics. Common characteristics is the idea that completes this fact. Size only would fill a different blank than common characteristics.

q: In the hierarchical scheme of classification, similar species are grouped together into the same _____.
e: In the hierarchical scheme of classification, similar species are grouped together into the same genus. Genus is the idea that completes this fact. Order would fill a different blank than genus.

q: In taxonomic hierarchy, similar genera are grouped together into _____.
e: In taxonomic hierarchy, similar genera are grouped together into families. Families is the idea that completes this fact. Orders would fill a different blank than families.

q: When writing the full classification of a species, it starts with the _____ rank.
e: When writing the full classification of a species, it starts with the kingdom rank. Kingdom is the idea that completes this fact. Species would fill a different blank than kingdom.

q: The taxonomic class of paddy plant (Oryza sativa) is _____.
e: The taxonomic class of paddy plant (Oryza sativa) is Monocotyledons. Monocotyledons is the idea that completes this fact. Magnoliophyta would fill a different blank than Monocotyledons.

q: The family name of paddy plant in the taxonomic classification is _____.
e: The family name of paddy plant in the taxonomic classification is Poaceae. Poaceae is the idea that completes this fact. Oryza would fill a different blank than Poaceae.

q: In human classification (Homo sapiens), the phylum is _____.
e: In human classification (Homo sapiens), the phylum is Chordata. Chordata is the idea that completes this fact. Mammalia would fill a different blank than Chordata.

q: The order to which humans belong in biological classification is _____.
e: The order to which humans belong in biological classification is Primates. Primates is the idea that completes this fact. Hominidae would fill a different blank than Primates.

q: The family name of human in the hierarchical classification is _____.
e: The family name of human in the hierarchical classification is Hominidae. Hominidae is the idea that completes this fact. Primates would fill a different blank than Hominidae.

q: The Swedish naturalist who introduced the Binomial System of Nomenclature was _____.
e: The Swedish naturalist who introduced the Binomial System of Nomenclature was Linnaeus. Linnaeus set up the two-word naming system still used for species. Darwin would fill a different blank than Linnaeus.

q: Linnaeus introduced the Binomial System of Nomenclature in the year _____.
e: Linnaeus introduced the Binomial System of Nomenclature in the year 1753. 1753 is the idea that completes this fact. 1707 would fill a different blank than 1753.

q: In the Binomial System of Nomenclature, each organism is given a _____ name.
e: In the Binomial System of Nomenclature, each organism is given a two-word name. Two-word is the idea that completes this fact. One-word would fill a different blank than two-word.

q: In a scientific name, the first word represents the _____.
e: In a scientific name, the first word represents the genus. Genus is the idea that completes this fact. Species would fill a different blank than genus.

q: In binomial nomenclature, the name of the genus must always start with a _____ letter.
e: In binomial nomenclature, the name of the genus must always start with a capital letter. Capital is the idea that completes this fact. Small would fill a different blank than capital.

q: The second word in a binomial scientific name represents the _____.
e: The second word in a binomial scientific name represents the species. A binomial name has two parts: genus then species, and it is written in italics in print. Order would fill a different blank than species.

q: The scientific name of human is _____.
e: The scientific name of human is Homo sapiens. Homo sapiens is the idea that completes this fact. Homo Hominidae would fill a different blank than Homo sapiens.

q: The scientific name of paddy plant is _____.
e: The scientific name of paddy plant is Oryza sativa. Oryza sativa is the idea that completes this fact. Poaceae sativa would fill a different blank than Oryza sativa.
